notablePrerequisites:
Stunt Double on the battlefield as a copy of Forensic Researcher.
Forensic Researcher and Stunt Double do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Stunt Double.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Stunt Double.
Activate Stunt Double by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Stunt Double ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.
